paragraphs.en: Unified AI governance for AI agents and users.
paragraphs.zh: 面向智能体与用户的统一 AI 治理。

paragraphs.en: See how Tailscale fits the systems your team already runs.
paragraphs.zh: 了解 Tailscale 如何适配您的团队已在运行的系统。

paragraphs.en: Start with your own devices. Bring the same simplicity to your team.
paragraphs.zh: 从你自己的设备开始。 为你的团队带来同样的简洁。

sents.en: Start with your own devices.
sents.zh: 从你自己的设备开始。

sents.en: Bring the same simplicity to your team.
sents.zh: 为你的团队带来同样的简洁。

paragraphs.en: If you’ve been following Tailscale at all, you know we’re really just a bunch of geeks who care a lot about internet connectivity. One thing we love to talk about is NAT Traversal. That’s one of the core value-adds with Tailscale: we tamed NAT . Not every network is friendly, but Tailscale can still find a path in a wide range of conditions. That’s not the only important thing for an internet protocol: the data plane also has to be performant.
paragraphs.zh: 如果你一直在关注 Tailscale，你就会知道我们其实只是一群非常在意互联网连接的极客。 我们喜欢谈论的话题之一就是 NAT 穿透。 这是 Tailscale 的核心增值点之一：我们驯服了 NAT。 并非所有网络都是友好的，但 Tailscale 仍能在各种条件下找到路径。 这对一个互联网协议来说并不是唯一重要的事情：数据平面也必须具备高性能。

sents.en: If you’ve been following Tailscale at all, you know we’re really just a bunch of geeks who care a lot about internet connectivity.
sents.zh: 如果你一直在关注 Tailscale，你就会知道我们其实只是一群非常在意互联网连接的极客。

sents.en: One thing we love to talk about is NAT Traversal.
sents.zh: 我们喜欢谈论的话题之一就是 NAT 穿透。

sents.en: That’s one of the core value-adds with Tailscale: we tamed NAT .
sents.zh: 这是 Tailscale 的核心增值点之一：我们驯服了 NAT。

sents.en: Not every network is friendly, but Tailscale can still find a path in a wide range of conditions.
sents.zh: 并非所有网络都是友好的，但 Tailscale 仍能在各种条件下找到路径。

sents.en: That’s not the only important thing for an internet protocol: the data plane also has to be performant.
sents.zh: 这对一个互联网协议来说并不是唯一重要的事情：数据平面也必须具备高性能。

paragraphs.en: Over the years we’ve been investing in making Tailscale fast. We started by increasing TCP throughput on Linux devices . Then we made significant breakthroughs in wireguard-go to surpass 10Gb/s on bare metal. We later leveraged segmentation offloads to increase throughput over 4x for UDP-based applications. Alongside these improvements to our data plane, we built primitives like Tailscale Peer Relays , which can improve network performance in tricky conditions .
paragraphs.zh: 多年来，我们一直致力于让 Tailscale 变得更快。 我们首先提升了 Linux 设备上的 TCP 吞吐量。 随后我们在 wireguard-go 中取得了重大突破，使裸机上的吞吐量超过了 10Gb/s。 后来我们利用分段卸载（segmentation offloads），将基于 UDP 的应用程序的吞吐量提升了 4 倍以上。 在改进数据平面的同时，我们还构建了 Tailscale Peer Relays 这样的基础组件，它可以在复杂网络条件下提升网络性能。

sents.en: Over the years we’ve been investing in making Tailscale fast.
sents.zh: 多年来，我们一直致力于让 Tailscale 变得更快。

sents.en: We started by increasing TCP throughput on Linux devices .
sents.zh: 我们首先提升了 Linux 设备上的 TCP 吞吐量。

sents.en: Then we made significant breakthroughs in wireguard-go to surpass 10Gb/s on bare metal.
sents.zh: 随后我们在 wireguard-go 中取得了重大突破，使裸机上的吞吐量超过了 10Gb/s。

sents.en: We later leveraged segmentation offloads to increase throughput over 4x for UDP-based applications.
sents.zh: 后来我们利用分段卸载（segmentation offloads），将基于 UDP 的应用程序的吞吐量提升了 4 倍以上。

sents.en: Alongside these improvements to our data plane, we built primitives like Tailscale Peer Relays , which can improve network performance in tricky conditions .
sents.zh: 在改进数据平面的同时，我们还构建了 Tailscale Peer Relays 这样的基础组件，它可以在复杂网络条件下提升网络性能。

paragraphs.en: All of this has made Tailscale practical for more performance-sensitive workloads. It means you can use Tailscale for continuous integration, agentic workflows, remote development environments, robotic edge devices, heavy data and telemetry workloads, and more. Tailscale helps those devices connect across a wide range of network conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 这一切使得 Tailscale 能够胜任更多对性能敏感的工作负载。 这意味着你可以将 Tailscale 用于持续集成、智能体工作流、远程开发环境、机器人边缘设备、大规模数据与遥测工作负载等更多场景。 Tailscale 帮助这些设备在各种网络条件下保持连接。

sents.en: All of this has made Tailscale practical for more performance-sensitive workloads.
sents.zh: 这一切使得 Tailscale 能够胜任更多对性能敏感的工作负载。

sents.en: It means you can use Tailscale for continuous integration, agentic workflows, remote development environments, robotic edge devices, heavy data and telemetry workloads, and more.
sents.zh: 这意味着你可以将 Tailscale 用于持续集成、智能体工作流、远程开发环境、机器人边缘设备、大规模数据与遥测工作负载等更多场景。

sents.en: Tailscale helps those devices connect across a wide range of network conditions.
sents.zh: Tailscale 帮助这些设备在各种网络条件下保持连接。

paragraphs.en: So yeah, we think Tailscale is fast. But we also think we can make it faster.
paragraphs.zh: 所以是的，我们认为 Tailscale 很快。 但我们也认为可以让它更快。

sents.en: So yeah, we think Tailscale is fast.
sents.zh: 所以是的，我们认为 Tailscale 很快。

sents.en: But we also think we can make it faster.
sents.zh: 但我们也认为可以让它更快。

paragraphs.en: Today we’ll detail how we’re boosting throughput for app connectors, subnet routers, and exit nodes, with some multi-queue technology (landing in the second half of 2026). We’ll also preview some throughput and memory overhead improvements we’re deploying in upcoming stable client releases. And we’ll look at some performance tooling issues we want to solve for our customers.
paragraphs.zh: 今天我们将详细介绍如何借助一项多队列技术（将于2026年下半年上线）来提升应用连接器、子网路由器和出口节点的吞吐量。 我们还将预览一些即将在稳定版客户端发布中部署的吞吐量和内存开销改进。 我们还会探讨一些希望为客户解决的性能工具问题。

sents.en: Today we’ll detail how we’re boosting throughput for app connectors, subnet routers, and exit nodes, with some multi-queue technology (landing in the second half of 2026).
sents.zh: 今天我们将详细介绍如何借助一项多队列技术（将于2026年下半年上线）来提升应用连接器、子网路由器和出口节点的吞吐量。

sents.en: We’ll also preview some throughput and memory overhead improvements we’re deploying in upcoming stable client releases.
sents.zh: 我们还将预览一些即将在稳定版客户端发布中部署的吞吐量和内存开销改进。

sents.en: And we’ll look at some performance tooling issues we want to solve for our customers.
sents.zh: 我们还会探讨一些希望为客户解决的性能工具问题。

paragraphs.en: Most network packets are tiny, like 1 KiB. But to use Linux’s most efficient throughput tools, like Generic Receive Offload (GRO), Tailscale has to be ready to accept 64 KiB of traffic at once. It’s a bit like container shipping: the ports, ships, and trucks are built for one container shape, however full it happens to be.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数网络数据包都很小，比如 1 KiB。 但要使用 Linux 最高效的吞吐工具，例如通用接收卸载（GRO），Tailscale 必须准备好一次性接收 64 KiB 的流量。 这有点像集装箱航运：港口、船只和卡车都是为一种集装箱形状而建造的，无论它实际装了多少货物。

sents.en: Most network packets are tiny, like 1 KiB.
sents.zh: 大多数网络数据包都很小，比如 1 KiB。

sents.en: But to use Linux’s most efficient throughput tools, like Generic Receive Offload (GRO), Tailscale has to be ready to accept 64 KiB of traffic at once.
sents.zh: 但要使用 Linux 最高效的吞吐工具，例如通用接收卸载（GRO），Tailscale 必须准备好一次性接收 64 KiB 的流量。

sents.en: It’s a bit like container shipping: the ports, ships, and trucks are built for one container shape, however full it happens to be.
sents.zh: 这有点像集装箱航运：港口、船只和卡车都是为一种集装箱形状而建造的，无论它实际装了多少货物。

paragraphs.en: Tailscale has to unpack those containers—every packet gets decrypted and delivered on its own. The wireguard-go implementation that informs Tailscale’s cryptography and networking essentials, only offers one 64 KiB buffer size to unpack into. So a 1 KiB packet is copied into its own 64 KiB buffer, every time. That’s a rich optimization target.
paragraphs.zh: Tailscale 必须解包这些容器——每个数据包都要单独解密并交付。 wireguard-go 的实现为 Tailscale 的加密和网络核心提供了基础，但它只提供一个 64 KiB 的缓冲区大小用于解包。 因此，一个 1 KiB 的数据包每次都会被复制到一个单独的 64 KiB 缓冲区中。 这是一个很有价值的优化点。

sents.en: Tailscale has to unpack those containers—every packet gets decrypted and delivered on its own.
sents.zh: Tailscale 必须解包这些容器——每个数据包都要单独解密并交付。

sents.en: The wireguard-go implementation that informs Tailscale’s cryptography and networking essentials, only offers one 64 KiB buffer size to unpack into.
sents.zh: wireguard-go 的实现为 Tailscale 的加密和网络核心提供了基础，但它只提供一个 64 KiB 的缓冲区大小用于解包。

sents.en: So a 1 KiB packet is copied into its own 64 KiB buffer, every time.
sents.zh: 因此，一个 1 KiB 的数据包每次都会被复制到一个单独的 64 KiB 缓冲区中。

sents.en: That’s a rich optimization target.
sents.zh: 这是一个很有价值的优化点。

paragraphs.en: On Linux and Android, Tailscale now leaves those packets where they landed. It identifies where each one starts and ends inside the single large read instead of copying it somewhere new. Small packets stay small in memory, many share one allocation, and they spend less time being copied. In itself, this led to a roughly 5% speed-up in many network configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Linux 和 Android 上，Tailscale 现在会让这些数据包留在它们落地的位置。 它在单次大读取中识别每个数据包的起点和终点，而不是把它复制到新的地方。 小数据包在内存中保持小体积，许多包共享一次内存分配，并且它们花费在复制上的时间更少。 仅此一项，就在许多网络配置中带来了大约 5% 的速度提升。

sents.en: On Linux and Android, Tailscale now leaves those packets where they landed.
sents.zh: 在 Linux 和 Android 上，Tailscale 现在会让这些数据包留在它们落地的位置。

sents.en: It identifies where each one starts and ends inside the single large read instead of copying it somewhere new.
sents.zh: 它在单次大读取中识别每个数据包的起点和终点，而不是把它复制到新的地方。

sents.en: Small packets stay small in memory, many share one allocation, and they spend less time being copied.
sents.zh: 小数据包在内存中保持小体积，许多包共享一次内存分配，并且它们花费在复制上的时间更少。

sents.en: In itself, this led to a roughly 5% speed-up in many network configurations.
sents.zh: 仅此一项，就在许多网络配置中带来了大约 5% 的速度提升。

paragraphs.en: Separately, we shortened packet queues—the lines packets wait in between stages of the pipeline. The queues are there to absorb bursts of traffic. Testing showed that most of that depth went unused, while shorter queues meant less waiting time and less memory overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 另外，我们缩短了数据包队列，也就是数据包在流水线各阶段之间排队等待的队列。 这些队列的作用是吸收突发的流量。 测试表明，队列的大部分深度并未被用到，而更短的队列意味着更少的等待时间和更少的内存开销。

sents.en: Separately, we shortened packet queues—the lines packets wait in between stages of the pipeline.
sents.zh: 另外，我们缩短了数据包队列，也就是数据包在流水线各阶段之间排队等待的队列。

sents.en: The queues are there to absorb bursts of traffic.
sents.zh: 这些队列的作用是吸收突发的流量。

sents.en: Testing showed that most of that depth went unused, while shorter queues meant less waiting time and less memory overhead.
sents.zh: 测试表明，队列的大部分深度并未被用到，而更短的队列意味着更少的等待时间和更少的内存开销。

paragraphs.en: What do we do with all that freed-up memory space? We passed the savings on to some of the hardest-working nodes: subnet routers and app connectors.
paragraphs.zh: 我们拿这些腾出来的内存空间做什么？ 我们把节省下来的资源分配给了一些工作最繁重的节点：子网路由器和应用连接器。

sents.en: What do we do with all that freed-up memory space?
sents.zh: 我们拿这些腾出来的内存空间做什么？

sents.en: We passed the savings on to some of the hardest-working nodes: subnet routers and app connectors.
sents.zh: 我们把节省下来的资源分配给了一些工作最繁重的节点：子网路由器和应用连接器。

paragraphs.en: Subnet routers can look completely different across different tailnets. For someone running a small homelab network, a subnet router can easily handle a small set of 192.168.x.y non-Tailscale devices. A subnet router that fronts a cloud deployment, one with hundreds of peers, will carry substantially more traffic.
paragraphs.zh: 在不同的 tailnet 之间，子网路由器的外观可能完全不同。 对于运行小型家庭实验室网络的人来说，一个子网路由器可以轻松处理一小组 192.168.x.y 的非 Tailscale 设备。 而作为云部署前置的子网路由器，如果面对数百个对等节点，承载的流量将大幅增加。

sents.en: Subnet routers can look completely different across different tailnets.
sents.zh: 在不同的 tailnet 之间，子网路由器的外观可能完全不同。

sents.en: For someone running a small homelab network, a subnet router can easily handle a small set of 192.168.x.y non-Tailscale devices.
sents.zh: 对于运行小型家庭实验室网络的人来说，一个子网路由器可以轻松处理一小组 192.168.x.y 的非 Tailscale 设备。

sents.en: A subnet router that fronts a cloud deployment, one with hundreds of peers, will carry substantially more traffic.
sents.zh: 而作为云部署前置的子网路由器，如果面对数百个对等节点，承载的流量将大幅增加。

paragraphs.en: Until recently, subnet routers, app connectors, and exit nodes processed packets for multiple independent streams in one ordered, single-thread pipeline. That meant a single lane was shared across many connections, because a receiving application must never see its own packets arrive out of order.
paragraphs.zh: 直到最近，子网路由器、应用连接器和出口节点都是在单个有序的单线程流水线中处理多个独立数据流的包。 这意味着许多连接共享同一条通道，因为接收应用程序绝不能看到自己的包乱序到达。

sents.en: Until recently, subnet routers, app connectors, and exit nodes processed packets for multiple independent streams in one ordered, single-thread pipeline.
sents.zh: 直到最近，子网路由器、应用连接器和出口节点都是在单个有序的单线程流水线中处理多个独立数据流的包。

sents.en: That meant a single lane was shared across many connections, because a receiving application must never see its own packets arrive out of order.
sents.zh: 这意味着许多连接共享同一条通道，因为接收应用程序绝不能看到自己的包乱序到达。

paragraphs.en: Having reduced our memory footprint, we had capacity to implement a multi-queue system: several lanes instead of one, scaled to the machine’s resources rather than the number of peers. Each stream of packets gets a lane and stays there, while the lanes run in parallel, allowing work to spread across CPU cores.
paragraphs.zh: 在降低内存占用之后，我们便有余力实现一个多队列系统：用多条通道代替单一通道，其数量根据机器的资源而非对等节点的数量来确定。 每个数据包流分配到一条通道并固定在其中，而各条通道并行运行，使工作得以分散到各个 CPU 核心上。

sents.en: Having reduced our memory footprint, we had capacity to implement a multi-queue system: several lanes instead of one, scaled to the machine’s resources rather than the number of peers.
sents.zh: 在降低内存占用之后，我们便有余力实现一个多队列系统：用多条通道代替单一通道，其数量根据机器的资源而非对等节点的数量来确定。

sents.en: Each stream of packets gets a lane and stays there, while the lanes run in parallel, allowing work to spread across CPU cores.
sents.zh: 每个数据包流分配到一条通道并固定在其中，而各条通道并行运行，使工作得以分散到各个 CPU 核心上。

paragraphs.en: It results in higher aggregate capacity and lower delay between receiving and forwarding packets for subnet routers and app connectors. Hardware you already have gets used more efficiently. App connectors and exit nodes, typically serving many users with short-lived connections, get a particularly noticeable boost.
paragraphs.zh: 这能为子网路由器和应用连接器带来更高的聚合容量，以及在接收和转发数据包之间更低的延迟。 你已有的硬件能得到更高效的利用。 应用连接器和出口节点通常以短连接服务众多用户，因此获得的提升尤为明显。

sents.en: It results in higher aggregate capacity and lower delay between receiving and forwarding packets for subnet routers and app connectors.
sents.zh: 这能为子网路由器和应用连接器带来更高的聚合容量，以及在接收和转发数据包之间更低的延迟。

sents.en: Hardware you already have gets used more efficiently.
sents.zh: 你已有的硬件能得到更高效的利用。

sents.en: App connectors and exit nodes, typically serving many users with short-lived connections, get a particularly noticeable boost.
sents.zh: 应用连接器和出口节点通常以短连接服务众多用户，因此获得的提升尤为明显。

paragraphs.en: “This translates into lower latency, essentially faster processing of data from the moment we read it off the wire to the moment we send it to the OS,” said Alex Valiushko, member of technical staff at Tailscale.
paragraphs.zh: “这意味着更低的延迟，本质上就是从我们从网络线上读取数据到将数据发送给操作系统这一过程中的数据处理速度更快，”Tailscale 的技术成员 Alex Valiushko 说。

paragraphs.en: Taking advantage of Linux’s writev capabilities in the Tailscale client, Tailscale can pass multiple pieces of packet data to the Linux kernel in one operation, rather than having to copy and combine those pieces before passing them to the kernel. The v in writev stands for “vector”: Tailscale can describe separate pieces of data that need to be moved, without moving them. It means fewer copies of packet data in memory, fewer write operations, and higher throughput.
paragraphs.zh: 借助 Linux 的 writev 能力，Tailscale 客户端可以在一次操作中把多段数据包数据传递给 Linux 内核，而不必在传递给内核之前先复制并合并这些数据段。 writev 中的 v 代表「向量」（vector）：Tailscale 可以描述需要移动的多段独立数据，而无需实际移动它们。 这意味着内存中数据包数据的副本更少、写操作更少，并且吞吐量更高。

sents.en: Taking advantage of Linux’s writev capabilities in the Tailscale client, Tailscale can pass multiple pieces of packet data to the Linux kernel in one operation, rather than having to copy and combine those pieces before passing them to the kernel.
sents.zh: 借助 Linux 的 writev 能力，Tailscale 客户端可以在一次操作中把多段数据包数据传递给 Linux 内核，而不必在传递给内核之前先复制并合并这些数据段。

sents.en: The v in writev stands for “vector”: Tailscale can describe separate pieces of data that need to be moved, without moving them.
sents.zh: writev 中的 v 代表「向量」（vector）：Tailscale 可以描述需要移动的多段独立数据，而无需实际移动它们。

sents.en: It means fewer copies of packet data in memory, fewer write operations, and higher throughput.
sents.zh: 这意味着内存中数据包数据的副本更少、写操作更少，并且吞吐量更高。

paragraphs.en: For now, these speed-ups are available only on Linux and, where applicable, Android systems. But we’ve also been working on features that apply to other systems. Tailscale clients will soon be able to use netmap caching to start more quickly in many conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 目前，这些加速功能仅在 Linux 系统上可用，在适用的地方也支持 Android 系统。 但我们也一直在开发适用于其他系统的功能。 Tailscale 客户端很快将能够使用 netmap 缓存，在许多情况下更快地启动。

sents.en: For now, these speed-ups are available only on Linux and, where applicable, Android systems.
sents.zh: 目前，这些加速功能仅在 Linux 系统上可用，在适用的地方也支持 Android 系统。

sents.en: But we’ve also been working on features that apply to other systems.
sents.zh: 但我们也一直在开发适用于其他系统的功能。

sents.en: Tailscale clients will soon be able to use netmap caching to start more quickly in many conditions.
sents.zh: Tailscale 客户端很快将能够使用 netmap 缓存，在许多情况下更快地启动。

paragraphs.en: A machine connecting to Tailscale usually starts by connecting to Tailscale’s control plane, in something like 100 milliseconds on a typical network. The machine authenticates and gets a "network map" (netmap) describing the devices it can reach and how to reach them. This startup process should feel fast, maybe instantaneous, and with a good network connection, it typically does.
paragraphs.zh: 一台连接到 Tailscale 的机器通常从连接 Tailscale 的控制平面开始，在典型网络上大约需要 100 毫秒。 机器完成身份验证后会获得一个「网络映射表」（netmap），描述它可以访问哪些设备以及如何访问它们。 这个启动过程应该感觉很快，甚至是瞬时的，而且在网络连接良好的情况下，通常确实如此。

sents.en: A machine connecting to Tailscale usually starts by connecting to Tailscale’s control plane, in something like 100 milliseconds on a typical network.
sents.zh: 一台连接到 Tailscale 的机器通常从连接 Tailscale 的控制平面开始，在典型网络上大约需要 100 毫秒。

sents.en: The machine authenticates and gets a "network map" (netmap) describing the devices it can reach and how to reach them.
sents.zh: 机器完成身份验证后会获得一个「网络映射表」（netmap），描述它可以访问哪些设备以及如何访问它们。

sents.en: This startup process should feel fast, maybe instantaneous, and with a good network connection, it typically does.
sents.zh: 这个启动过程应该感觉很快，甚至是瞬时的，而且在网络连接良好的情况下，通常确实如此。

paragraphs.en: But when you’re on bad airplane Wi-Fi, or inside a hotel with aggressive filtering, or other not-great connectivity setups, it can take a while for the machine to reach the control plane—and sometimes you may not be able to reach it at all. It’s often not obvious where the problem is, but the effect is that you can’t reach other devices.
paragraphs.zh: 但当你身处 Wi-Fi 信号很差的飞机上，或在有严格过滤的酒店里，或其他网络连接不佳的环境中时，机器可能需要一段时间才能连上控制平面——有时你甚至可能完全无法连接到它。 问题出在哪里通常并不明显，但其结果就是你无法连接到其他设备。

sents.en: But when you’re on bad airplane Wi-Fi, or inside a hotel with aggressive filtering, or other not-great connectivity setups, it can take a while for the machine to reach the control plane—and sometimes you may not be able to reach it at all.
sents.zh: 但当你身处 Wi-Fi 信号很差的飞机上，或在有严格过滤的酒店里，或其他网络连接不佳的环境中时，机器可能需要一段时间才能连上控制平面——有时你甚至可能完全无法连接到它。

sents.en: It’s often not obvious where the problem is, but the effect is that you can’t reach other devices.
sents.zh: 问题出在哪里通常并不明显，但其结果就是你无法连接到其他设备。

paragraphs.en: Even under ideal network conditions, 100 milliseconds of startup latency may be too much for some latency-sensitive workloads.
paragraphs.zh: 即使在理想的网络条件下，100 毫秒的启动延迟对某些延迟敏感型工作负载来说也可能过长。

paragraphs.en: Netmap caching helps machines get connected when the control plane is not quickly reachable. When it’s enabled, each device on your tailnet stores a copy of the netmap on disk. When a device starts up, it can use that cached copy to establish connections with other devices on the tailnet, until it’s able to contact the control plane to get the latest info. (These connections are negotiated between the devices directly, and Tailscale does not see any of the traffic, as usual).
paragraphs.zh: Netmap 缓存有助于在控制平面无法快速访问时让设备建立连接。 启用后，tailnet 上的每台设备都会在磁盘上存储一份 netmap 副本。 当设备启动时，它可以利用该缓存副本与 tailnet 上的其他设备建立连接，直到能够联系控制平面获取最新信息为止。 （如往常一样，这些连接由设备之间直接协商，Tailscale 不会看到任何流量。）

sents.en: Netmap caching helps machines get connected when the control plane is not quickly reachable.
sents.zh: Netmap 缓存有助于在控制平面无法快速访问时让设备建立连接。

sents.en: When it’s enabled, each device on your tailnet stores a copy of the netmap on disk.
sents.zh: 启用后，tailnet 上的每台设备都会在磁盘上存储一份 netmap 副本。

sents.en: When a device starts up, it can use that cached copy to establish connections with other devices on the tailnet, until it’s able to contact the control plane to get the latest info.
sents.zh: 当设备启动时，它可以利用该缓存副本与 tailnet 上的其他设备建立连接，直到能够联系控制平面获取最新信息为止。

sents.en: (These connections are negotiated between the devices directly, and Tailscale does not see any of the traffic, as usual).
sents.zh: （如往常一样，这些连接由设备之间直接协商，Tailscale 不会看到任何流量。）

paragraphs.en: “Bad network conditions—that’s really the space where people can get a lot of utility out of netmap caching,” said Claus Lensbøl, member of technical staff. “[A device client says], ‘You know what? We haven’t talked to control yet. We’ll probably get there soon. In the meantime, you can still start doing something.’”
paragraphs.zh: 「恶劣的网络环境——这正是人们能从 netmap 缓存中获得大量实用价值的场景，」技术团队成员 Claus Lensbøl 说，「[设备客户端会说]：『你知道吗？ 我们还没和 control 通信。 我们可能很快就会连上。 在此期间，你仍然可以开始做些事情。』」

sents.en: We haven’t talked to control yet.
sents.zh: 我们还没和 control 通信。

sents.en: We’ll probably get there soon.
sents.zh: 我们可能很快就会连上。

sents.en: In the meantime, you can still start doing something.’”
sents.zh: 在此期间，你仍然可以开始做些事情。』」

paragraphs.en: There are a few limitations. Caching can only work if the device has previously connected to the tailnet at least once, to fetch a network map from the control plane. In addition, netmap caching requires the device to have persistent disk space to store the cache. We’ve taken care to minimize unnecessary disk writes, but in some cases you may not want to enable it. For example, on exceptionally large tailnets, updating a cache may require a lot of disk traffic. Likewise, devices that use slow or wear-sensitive storage like SD cards may prefer not to enable netmap caching.
paragraphs.zh: 存在一些局限性。 缓存只有在设备此前至少连接过一次 tailnet、并从控制平面获取网络映射的情况下才能生效。 此外，网络映射缓存要求设备具有持久化的磁盘空间来存储缓存。 我们已注意尽量减少不必要的磁盘写入，但在某些情况下您可能不希望启用它。 例如，在规模特别大的 tailnet 中，更新缓存可能需要大量的磁盘流量。 同样，使用慢速或易损耗存储介质（如 SD 卡）的设备可能更倾向于不启用网络映射缓存。

sents.en: There are a few limitations.
sents.zh: 存在一些局限性。

sents.en: Caching can only work if the device has previously connected to the tailnet at least once, to fetch a network map from the control plane.
sents.zh: 缓存只有在设备此前至少连接过一次 tailnet、并从控制平面获取网络映射的情况下才能生效。

sents.en: In addition, netmap caching requires the device to have persistent disk space to store the cache.
sents.zh: 此外，网络映射缓存要求设备具有持久化的磁盘空间来存储缓存。

sents.en: We’ve taken care to minimize unnecessary disk writes, but in some cases you may not want to enable it.
sents.zh: 我们已注意尽量减少不必要的磁盘写入，但在某些情况下您可能不希望启用它。

sents.en: For example, on exceptionally large tailnets, updating a cache may require a lot of disk traffic.
sents.zh: 例如，在规模特别大的 tailnet 中，更新缓存可能需要大量的磁盘流量。

sents.en: Likewise, devices that use slow or wear-sensitive storage like SD cards may prefer not to enable netmap caching.
sents.zh: 同样，使用慢速或易损耗存储介质（如 SD 卡）的设备可能更倾向于不启用网络映射缓存。

paragraphs.en: For most devices on most tailnets, though, this feature can notably speed up how quickly devices can establish contact with each other at startup. We’ve seen tailnets with poor control plane reachability start sending through the data plane, on a “warm” cache start, one to two orders of magnitude faster than from a “cold” start. For devices facing variable startup latency, or far away from a DERP server or the control plane, the benefits are particularly tangible.
paragraphs.zh: 不过，对于大多数 tailnet 上的大多数设备而言，此功能可以显著加快设备在启动时相互建立联系的速度。 我们见过控制平面可达性较差的 tailnet，在「热」缓存启动下通过数据平面开始发送数据的速度，比「冷」启动快一到两个数量级。 对于启动延迟不稳定、或距离 DERP 服务器或控制平面较远的设备，其好处尤为明显。

sents.zh: 不过，对于大多数 tailnet 上的大多数设备而言，此功能可以显著加快设备在启动时相互建立联系的速度。

sents.en: We’ve seen tailnets with poor control plane reachability start sending through the data plane, on a “warm” cache start, one to two orders of magnitude faster than from a “cold” start.

sents.zh: 对于启动延迟不稳定、或距离 DERP 服务器或控制平面较远的设备，其好处尤为明显。

paragraphs.en: Sure, we think Tailscale is fast. But you shouldn’t have to trust us on that. That’s why we’re exploring a Tailscale-aware monitoring and testing toolkit. We want to give our customers the tooling they need to test, diagnose, and understand their network configuration, in a way that’s Tailscale-native.
paragraphs.zh: 当然，我们认为 Tailscale 很快。 但你不应该只凭我们的一面之词就相信这一点。 这就是为什么我们正在探索一个感知 Tailscale 的监控与测试工具包。 我们希望以一种 Tailscale 原生的方式，为客户提供测试、诊断和理解其网络配置所需的工具。

sents.zh: 我们希望以一种 Tailscale 原生的方式，为客户提供测试、诊断和理解其网络配置所需的工具。
